summary: Verified the new Prospects (Go Perks west-Melbourne deals membership) feature end-to-end. Backend: full regression /app/backend/tests = 120 passed / 1 intentional skip (incl. 3 test_prospects.py: owner-only ACL, 65+ seeded rows all have @email+suburb+source_url, add/edit/delete + 400 on invalid category/status). Extra curl checks confirm owner 200 / anon 401 / staff 403 (created TEST staff test_staff_prospects@example.com for the staff check). Frontend (1440x900 + 390x844 verified): admin-nav-prospects visible for owner, mobile hamburger shows admin-mnav-prospects (visible=True). /admin/prospects loads admin-prospects-page; DataTable id 'prospects' renders 65 rows with business name + website link, Type, Suburb, mono email + prospect-copy-<id> button (65 copies), Phone, Status select (prospect-status-<id>), Notes, 'Email found on' hostname. Filters prospects-filter-{all,new,contacted,interested,joined,not_interested} render with counts (All 65 / New 65 initially). prospects-search filters live ('cafe' -> 28 rows). prospects-export CSV present. Changing a row's status select (set 3 Grains new->contacted) does NOT open the dialog, and persists after hard reload (verified status still 'contacted' after reload). Row-cell click opens prospect-dialog with all 10 expected testids present (name/category/suburb/email/phone/website/status/notes/save/delete) and shows 'Email found on:' source link. prospect-add-btn opens empty dialog; adding 'TEST_ Prospect UI' creates a row whose dialog shows 'Added by you' source; prospect-delete-btn with window.confirm removes the row (verified via API — 0 TEST_ prospects remain). No 'Send email' button or any send/email-dispatch UI on the page. At 390px the table overflows horizontally (width 1216px inside its scroll container as expected) and the dialog fits on screen. Restored the one seeded row I touched (3 Grains) back to status 'new' at the end. No defects. Test credentials and seeded prospect data are unchanged.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/prospects.py (102 lines) is clean, owner-only, uses Pydantic validation and shared check() for category/status/email. seed_prospects() is idempotent (only runs when collection is empty) — good.
ProspectsPage.jsx correctly stops propagation on status select and copy button so row-click dialog isn't triggered — verified in test.
ProspectDialog uses window.confirm for delete; fine for admin tools but a shadcn ConfirmDialog would be more consistent with the rest of admin. Not blocking.

StatusSelect is rendered 65× in a single table; using plain <select> keeps it light. Filter counts render once per load (don't live-update after a status change until reload) — acceptable UX because the row's own pill updates immediately; the filter pill counts only refresh on next load. If needed, derive counts from `rows` state instead of once-only.
navigator.clipboard may be blocked in some environments (shows a 'Couldn't copy' toast) — the UX already handles the rejection branch correctly.

success_rate.backend: 100% (120 passed, 1 intentional skip; 3/3 prospects tests; owner/staff/anon ACL confirmed)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on prospects table, filters, search, CSV, status inline-edit (no dialog), row-click dialog with all 10 fields, add TEST_ prospect with 'Added by you' source, delete, mobile hamburger menu + admin-mnav-prospects, 390px layout

test_credentials: Used seed admin admin@tinysvouchers.com.au / TinyAdmin!2026 and member member@tinysvouchers.com.au / Member!2026. Created TEST staff test_staff_prospects@example.com / StaffP!2026 to verify 403 (no DELETE /api/admin/users endpoint exists so it lingers; name is TEST-prefixed and has no business attached — safe).
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted one TEST_ Prospect UI prospect via the UI. 3 Grains seeded prospect was temporarily set to 'contacted' and restored to 'new' at the end of the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Prospects testids: admin-nav-prospects (desktop), admin-mnav-prospects (mobile hamburger), admin-prospects-page, prospect-add-btn, DataTable id='prospects' with prospects-filter-{all,new,contacted,interested,joined,not_interested}, prospects-search, prospects-export, prospect-status-<id>, prospect-copy-<id>, and dialog prospect-dialog with inputs prospect-name/category/suburb/email/phone/website/status/notes and prospect-save-btn / prospect-delete-btn. Backend: GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/admin/prospects (owner-only, staff 403, anon 401). 65 seeded rows from /app/backend/prospects_seed.json. Note: TEST staff id 6aead11c02af2a4868b02cfd lingers (no DELETE endpoint). To re-run only prospects pytest: `cd /app/backend && pytest tests/test_prospects.py -v`.
rca of the issue: No defects found. Feature meets all spec items: owner-only ACL on all 4 methods, 65 seeded businesses with researched emails + source URLs, inline status edit that doesn't open the dialog and persists, row-click edit dialog with all fields, add/delete flow with 'Added by you' source, filters+search+CSV, no email-sending UI on the page, 400 on invalid category/status, mobile-friendly.
